headline: Colonials Roll Across Weathered Expanse as Wardens Sweep Palantine Berm
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has swung hard since our last edition: the Colonial counterstroke noted at dawn wiring has carried the field, and where the Wardens lately counted four posts against two, the ledger now reads six Colonial to one Warden with two grounds in ruin, sixty-four actions logged and Crow's Nest and Wightwalk the busiest grounds. Palantine Berm, by contrast, has been closed out entirely, the Wardens now holding all seven posts after hours of struggle about The Droll, though the freshest stroke there came near press time. Callahan's Passage remains the bloodiest field: eleven thousand Colonial and twelve thousand Warden casualties in a day, one Warden post reduced to no-man's-land, and Crumbling Post still the most-fought ground, its latest entry filed as this edition went to press. Stlican Shelf has gone eight posts to one for the Colonials, Breaker Town and Port of Rime busy. The Nevish Line has seen no post change since evening, yet Warden losses there mount swiftly. Stonecradle stirs about The Reach; Kuura Strand and Callums Cape have gone quiet. The five hundred and twenty-first day closes with thirty-four victory towns still the prize.
